# Integrated baseline fixture provenance

These synthetic, dimensionless standard-error cases preserve the exact and legacy critical-effect
distances frozen from behavior source
`830756ecb11b4e8161f8dfe1fc75afc346ef4467` and independently carried into the
`wald-inference` v0.3.0 scientific-reference suite. They contain no patient or study records.

The exact values use the v0.3.0 two-sided selected-claim inversion at alpha 0.05 and target
probability 0.80. The legacy values preserve the historical fixed z-sum benchmark. The fixture is
repository-authored JSON under the repository MIT license; no external table or dataset is copied.
